detect_adsorbate_dissociation: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if the adsorbate connectivity changed between initial and final relaxation structures
detect_surface_reconstruction: use DetectTrajAnomaly to test if bond breaking or forming events occurred on the surface during relaxation
detect_adsorbate_desorption: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if the adsorbate has lost all connections to the slab atoms
detect_adsorbate_intercalation: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if any adsorbate atom is interacting with a frozen bulk atom
compute_connectivity_matrix: use DetectTrajAnomaly to generate a connectivity matrix for an ASE Atoms object using natural cutoffs
